svg.text: Project goal and what we found
Goal: recover the supplied FPGA crypto IP, verify it, then have AI insert and exploit one hardware
Bitstream recovered; cipher reconstructed; self-checking baseline passes 127/127.
AI-generated Trojan + exploit: 140/140 simulation checks; waveforms + resource diff captured.
Confirmed end-to-end on the real Hackster board: dormant in normal use, payload fires on cue.
One reproducible command regenerates every simulation result.
